_comment: Satellite 'dot' nodes: small 7px blobs anchored to a position on the
1920px ring map (see ring.json). `anchor` is a ring index 0..1919 —
repositionable at runtime via POST /satellites/{name} or by editing
this file, WITHOUT altering the ring's 1920px topology or its 3 strip
segments. mode 'mirror' (default) shows a 7px window of the ring
canvas centered on anchor, wrapping at the seam; 'independent' shows
a flat `color` instead, ignoring the ring, until switched back.
ANCHORS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS (0 and 960 — opposite sides of the
1920px loop) pending physical positioning in the room.
